title: Wide-baseline rig for two depth cameras
summary: Two Azure Kinect DK depth cameras on their sides at the ends of a 1 m aluminium tube, toed in on one person for a fuller point cloud, worn on backpack straps with a chest rest and two grips.
material: PLA-CF (black structure) and PLA (orange pad, clips, phone mount, knobs); 25x25x1.5 aluminium tube
notes: Own project. Print the tube fit coupon first and pick the sleeve size before the clamps. Plates on Gås: Fit test: tube sleeves: 0.9 h, 24 g (PLA-CF, day, ~1 h); Black 1: camera clamps and cradles: 11.4 h, 313 g (PLA-CF, night); Black 2: yoke and a grip: 10.9 h, 320 g (PLA-CF, night); Black 3: grip clamps and a grip: 7.1 h, 186 g (PLA-CF, day/evening); Orange: chest pad, clips, phone mount, knobs: 6.9 h, 178 g (PLA, day). Total 37.1 h, 1022 g. 30 % gyroid, 5 walls, 0.16 mm layers; no supports; every plate passed the toolpath review. Plates over 6 h: reboot Gås first. Toe-in presets 1.0/1.5/2.0/3.0 m (detent screw). Checked against 13 automatic targets (13 pass): field of view at every preset, framing a person, cooling, plug room, cables, weight, chest force, bar flex, bed fit, supports.
